body.intent: Fix Run drivers burn CPU while they wait: each 'rhiza run start --foreground' driver uses ~14% of a core continuously (2.5-3 CPU-min over 19 min of wall time, measured 2026-11-05 on drivers 3213906/3213914/3213930 while their runs sat in build/review), so 5-7 live runs spend about a core on supervision alone on the 4-core VM and load reached 41. rhiza apply also takes ~3 s per write in this repo. Profile a driver's poll loop and rhiza apply: likely re-reading and folding the whole model log (now large) on every poll or write; poll cheaply (file mtimes or the run journal), cache the fold, and add a CPU budget test for an idle driver.
